{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-run the full pipeline and explicitly print all key intermediate values

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_count = (data['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f"Number of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {sentinel_count}")

# Check for duplicate patient_id entries
duplicate_count = data['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id entries: {duplicate_count}")

# Filter out sentinel values
valid_data = data[data['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]
print(f"Number of rows after removing -999 sentinel values: {len(valid_data)}")

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping highest sample_seq
deduplicated_data = valid_data.sort_values(by=['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False]).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')
n_patients = len(deduplicated_data)
mean_baseline = deduplicated_data['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

print(f"Number of patients after deduplication: {n_patients}")
print(f"Mean baseline biomarker value (ng/mL): {mean_baseline:.2f}")"}
